Name: Seraiah, Son of Tanhumeth
Summary: Seraiah, son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, was one of the captains who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Seraiah comes to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
RelatedPeople: Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Tanhumeth, Father of Seraiah; Gedaliah; Johanan, Son of Kareah
LifeLesson: Small names in a remnant list are still lives God kept.
